scripts.start: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev --config dist/server/wrangler.json --ip 127.0.0.1 --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
scripts.mobile:apk: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
